title: Parametric vector flows for registration fields in bounded domains with applications to nonlinear interpolation of shock-dominated flows
summary: We present a registration procedure for parametric model order reduction (MOR) in two- and three-dimensional bounded domains. In the MOR framework, registration methods exploit solution snapshots to identify a parametric coordinate transformation that improves the approximation of the solution set through linear subspaces.
